children.name: Message text
children.text: Hey Alex. How did your riverside walk go? Did the sketchbook make it out of your bag?

children.name: Message text
children.text: It did, actually. I drew the bridge. But everyone seemed to be with someone. I felt a bit out of place.

children.name: Message text
children.text: That sounds like a lonely moment in the middle of something you enjoyed. You still made a little space for yourself and your drawing. What was it about the bridge that caught your eye?

children.name: Message text
children.text: The light, I think. I used to sketch with Maya. Maybe I’ll send it to her.

children.name: Message text
children.text: I remember you two used to draw together. Sending it could be a small way to share a piece of your new world with her. No perfect message needed. Even “thought you’d like this” is a beginning.

children.name: Placeholder
children.text: Tell me what’s on your mind…
